statement: The critical dimension for the one-phase Bernoulli problem. Establishes seven as the first dimension admitting a nonflat, one-homogeneous global minimizer of the one-phase Bernoulli energy. Consequently, minimizing free boundaries are smooth through dimension six, and their singular sets have dimension at most $`n-7`$ in higher dimensions.
